por-shell:
cat > /home/learner/aso/f22/por-shell.sh <<'SOLUCION'
#!/bin/bash
[ $# -eq 1 ] || { echo 'uso: por-shell.sh INTÉRPRETE' >&2; exit 1; }
n=0
while IFS=: read -r login x uid gid gecos home shell; do
    [ "$shell" = "$1" ] || continue
    echo "$login"
    (( n++ ))
done < /etc/passwd
(( n > 0 )) || { echo "error: ningún usuario usa $1" >&2; exit 2; }
echo "Total: $n"
SOLUCION
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/f22/por-shell.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/f22/por-shell.sh
miembros:
cat > /home/learner/aso/f22/miembros.sh <<'SOLUCION'
#!/bin/bash
[ $# -eq 1 ] || { echo 'uso: miembros.sh GRUPO' >&2; exit 1; }
linea=$(getent group "$1") || { echo "error: $1 no existe" >&2; exit 2; }
IFS=: read -r nombre x gid lista <<< "$linea"
principales=()
while IFS=: read -r login x uid g resto; do
    [ "$g" = "$gid" ] && principales+=("$login")
done < /etc/passwd
IFS=, read -r -a secundarios <<< "$lista"
echo "Principales: ${principales[*]:-(ninguno)}"
echo "Secundarios: ${secundarios[*]:-(ninguno)}"
SOLUCION
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/f22/miembros.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/f22/miembros.sh
ficha:
cat > /home/learner/aso/f22/ficha.sh <<'SOLUCION'
#!/bin/bash
[ $# -eq 1 ] || { echo 'uso: ficha.sh USUARIO' >&2; exit 1; }
linea=$(getent passwd "$1") || { echo "error: $1 no existe" >&2; exit 2; }
IFS=: read -r login x uid gid gecos home shell <<< "$linea"
cat <<FIN
=== Ficha de $login ===
UID: $uid
Grupo: $(id -gn "$login")
Home: $home
Shell: $shell
FIN
SOLUCION
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/f22/ficha.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/f22/ficha.sh
parejas:
cat > /home/learner/aso/f22/parejas.sh <<'SOLUCION'
#!/bin/bash
[ $# -eq 2 ] || { echo 'uso: parejas.sh F1 F2' >&2; exit 1; }
for f in "$1" "$2"; do
    [ -f "$f" ] && [ -r "$f" ] || { echo "error: no se puede leer $f" >&2; exit 2; }
done
exec 3<"$1" 4<"$2"
while IFS= read -r -u3 a && IFS= read -r -u4 b; do
    echo "$a | $b"
done
exec 3<&- 4<&-
SOLUCION
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/f22/parejas.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/f22/parejas.sh
cadena:
cat > /home/learner/aso/f22/cadena.sh <<'SOLUCION'
#!/bin/bash
[ $# -eq 1 ] || { echo 'uso: cadena.sh TEXTO' >&2; exit 1; }
t=$1
(( ${#t} >= 3 )) || { echo 'error: el texto debe tener al menos 3 caracteres' >&2; exit 2; }
echo "Longitud: ${#t}"
echo "Primeros 3: ${t:0:3}"
echo "Últimos 3: ${t: -3}"
echo "Sin extremos: ${t:1:${#t}-2}"
SOLUCION
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/f22/cadena.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/f22/cadena.sh
campos:
cat > /home/learner/aso/f22/campos.sh <<'SOLUCION'
#!/bin/bash
[ $# -eq 1 ] || { echo 'uso: campos.sh USUARIO' >&2; exit 1; }
linea=$(getent passwd "$1") || { echo "error: $1 no existe" >&2; exit 2; }
IFS=: read -r -a campos <<< "$linea"
echo "Campos: ${#campos[@]}"
for i in "${!campos[@]}"; do
    echo "[$i] ${campos[i]}"
done
r=${campos[-1]}
for (( i = ${#campos[@]} - 2; i >= 0; i-- )); do
    r+=":${campos[i]}"
done
echo "Al revés: $r"
SOLUCION
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/f22/campos.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/f22/campos.sh
